Name: Dialogue Log
Author: Lyhsayin
Description:
Add a dialogue log into the game.

The current (rather early) implementation logs the dialogues in the chat box, giving the game an unintended familiar MMO-feel.

Additionally, the following features can be toggled in the mod's configuration :

[list]
[*]Replacing the name of the speaker with an emoji of the character when possible
[*]Extending the maximum number of messages displayed in the chat box from 10 to 15
[*]Preventing the logs from popping up as chat notifications (either globally or specifically during events)
[*]Changing the width of the ChatBox and the opacity of the chat notifications background
[*]Logging the speech bubbles / "texts abovehead" (see Known issues)
[/list]Includes config translations for French, Spanish, Portugese and German.
Furthermore, there is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36913]Chinese translation[/url] made by wy189 and a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37337]Korean translation[/url] made by jjongleee.

[b]Known issues:[/b]

[list]
[*]For technical reasons, some speech bubbles may not be logged even when the option to do so is enabled. This mostly occurs to random NPC salutations and other non-critical ambient messages, it should not happen with event and location-related messages.
[/list]
